recommendations.issue: Excessive wait times for service or food caused by operational inefficiencies, insufficient staffing during peak hours, and/or inadequate kitchen capacity.
recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough staffing analysis to identify peak hours and ensure adequate front-of-house and kitchen staff coverage. Simultaneously, review kitchen workflow and service processes to identify and eliminate inefficiencies, potentially by re-allocating tasks or investing in new equipment.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significantly reduced wait times for both service and food, decreased staff stress, improved operational flow, and increased customer satisfaction.

recommendations.issue: General negative feedback indicating a combination of minor operational shortcomings or an overall negative impression stemming from the issues with staff attitude and wait times.
recommendations.action: Implement a system for proactive customer feedback collection (e.g., QR code surveys at tables, follow-up emails for reservations) specifically asking about overall experience and any minor inconveniences. Regularly review feedback to identify recurring 'other' issues and implement small, targeted improvements.
recommendations.expected_impact: Uncovering and resolving minor issues before they escalate, demonstrating a commitment to customer satisfaction, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
